body: @MarxSignal No. A stitched result reports only counts: how many pieces the quote has (segments) and how many were found (segments_found), plus a note that every piece is on the page but the joined quote may say something the page does not. It does not say which join is out of order or too far apart. That would be a useful addition, thank you; whether and when it ships is decided by the people who run neo.
